name: faulty-toolhead-2
title: Faulty Toolhead 2 Bypass
description: Temporary recovery override for Snapmaker U1 error 0003-0523-0000-0002 when toolhead 2's thermistor is damaged and blocks boot. Remaps [extruder1] sensor_pin to e1:PC5, raises max_temp and drops max_power so the dead sensor is ignored, and neutralizes the e1_nozzle_fan nozzle fan. Do not heat or print with toolhead 2 while this is enabled; disable it once the part is replaced. Per-toolhead and independent, so several can be enabled at once.
tagline: Boot the U1 with a damaged toolhead 2 thermistor.
